title: Haye jab imam mai bana
body:
Haye jab imam mai bana
Haaye Aashur Ko Ghash Se Jo Phuphi a.s Jaan Ney Uthaaya
Jalta Hua Lut'ta Hua Samaan Nazar Aaya
Baba a.s Na Alamdaar a.s Na Lashkar Tha Hamara
Maan Behno'n Ke Sar Per Bhi Ridaa'on Ko Naa Paya
Uss Haal Main Dastaar-e-Imamat Ko Sambhala
